corrections.label: effect of exchange rate
corrections.why: The Q3 FY2015 release (18-Mar-2015) prints the nine-month effect of exchange rate changes on cash as +104; operating 3,473 + investing (4,382) + financing 1,583 = 674 against the printed net increase of 570, so the effect is (104). The Form 10-Q for the quarter shows (104).

guidance_cy26.note: Outlook as printed in the release. Excludes further mark-to-market adjustments (retirement plans, FedEx Freight stake).

targets_2029.note: The filings refer to 'calendar 2029 financial performance targets' but no numeric targets were found in an EDGAR-filed exhibit; investor-day material on the investor-relations site is not reachable from the build environment. No 2029 target is used in the model.

spin_off.note: FedEx Freight spun off 1-Jun-2026 (80.1% distributed); retained 19.9% carried at fair value in 'Short-term investment'; $1.2bn unrealised loss in Q3/26, $3.3bn cumulative gain in the four months to 30-Sep-2026; expected to be fully monetised within 12 months of 30-Sep-2026.

supply_chain_sale.note: Revenue and profit of FedEx Supply Chain are not disclosed (inside Corporate, other, and eliminations).

debt.at_2026_09_30: Long-term debt less current portion $17,304m + current portion $2,051m (in accrued and other liabilities) = $19,355m incl. finance leases; carrying value ex finance leases $17.6bn; weighted-average rate 3.75%; debt / adjusted EBITDA (credit-agreement definition) 1.9x vs 3.5x covenant; no commercial paper or revolver borrowings ($3.5bn available: $1.75bn three-year to Mar-2028, $1.75bn five-year to Mar-2030).

tariff_refunds.note: IEEPA tariff refunds received from CBP and held for refund to customers ($2.7bn of the $8.0bn cash at 30-Sep-2026); liability recognised when cash is received.

inpost.note: 37% of Lux TopCo (InPost) for EUR 2.2bn; equity method; no equity earnings recognised to 30-Sep-2026.

price.sec_reference: average price paid for shares repurchased in September 2026: $293.07 (Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 30-Sep-2026, Part II Item 2)

CQ3-26.note: Form 10-Q, Note 1 'Accrued and other liabilities': current portion of long-term debt $2,051m and current operating lease liabilities $2,511m (the release balance sheet shows them inside 'Accrued and other liabilities').
